title: EtherNet/IP Driver Configuration
description: Per-driver-type schema for `type: ethernet_ip` entries (FR-DF-004; Sprint C7, XEDGE-471/473/474/475; CRD §4.5). CIP originator for ControlLogix/CompactLogix via `pycomm3` (ADR-012 §1) -- explicit (acyclic) messaging only, polled at `scan_rate_ms`. No mainstream Python CIP library implements Class 1 implicit I/O; XEDGE-DR-001 Q-7 accepted scan-interval polling as satisfying the CRD's 'cyclic exchange' requirement (ADR-012 §1) -- this is *not* true implicit I/O, and must not be presented as such anywhere this schema's fields surface in the Web UI.

host.description: Controller IP address or hostname, e.g. '192.168.1.50'.

port.description: TCP port for CIP explicit messaging. 44818 is the EtherNet/IP standard; almost never anything else.

slot.description: Backplane slot number of the CPU module -- 0 for most CompactLogix (single-slot); the actual chassis slot (commonly 0-16) for a ControlLogix rack.

scan_rate_ms.description: FR-SA-009 / XEDGE-474: 50ms minimum, 24h maximum -- this group's tags are read via an explicit-messaging request repeated at this interval, polled, not CIP Class 1 implicit I/O (no mainstream Python CIP library implements that; see this schema's own top-level description). Unlike Modbus's block-batched reads, this floor has not been lowered for CIP explicit messaging's per-request session/encapsulation overhead -- it is a schema limit, not a verified achievable rate.

deadband.description: FR-DP-006: change-of-value suppression, applied by the pipeline after this driver emits a raw TagUpdate -- not enforced by this driver itself. Applies to every numeric tag in this group.

tag_name.description: The controller's own symbolic tag name, e.g. 'MyTag', 'Program:MainProgram.MyTag', an array element 'MyArray[3]', or a UDT member 'MyUdt.Member'.

access.description: XEDGE-473: 'read_only' rejects a write-back attempt against this tag (e.g. a status/feedback tag that must never be driven); 'write_only' excludes it from the group's scan_rate_ms poll (e.g. a control-only output tag), matching xedge.drivers.modbus.polling's identical field.

scaling.description: FR-DP-003: engineering_value = raw * scale + offset. Ignored for a non-numeric tag value (e.g. BOOL, STRING).
